<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
load_gguf(path, *, mmap: bool = True) -> GGUFFile
```

Part of [`evoxc.formats`](/api/evoxc/formats/)

Open and validate a GGUF v2/v3 file.

## Parameters

- `path` — Path to the `.gguf` file.

- `mmap` · `bool` — `True` (default) memory-maps the file; `False` reads eagerly
  and returns independent writable arrays.

## Returns

- `GGUFFile` — A validated `GGUFFile`.  Close it (or use it as a context manager) when done.
